class.name: TemporalUpscalerInputs
class.brief_description: The per-view inputs passed to [method TemporalUpscalerExtension._process].
class.description: Holds the textures and camera values a temporal upscaler needs for one view of one frame. The engine creates a new instance for each [method TemporalUpscalerExtension._process] call; it is only valid during that call.

members.member: The internal-resolution color texture to upscale.
The time since the previous frame, in seconds.
The camera's vertical field of view, in degrees.
The size of the internal textures, in pixels. With dynamic resolution it can change from frame to frame, up to [member max_internal_size], and the internal textures are reallocated at each new size.
The camera jitter for this frame, in internal pixels.

The largest [member internal_size] the viewport can use without a full reconfigure, in pixels. Size history and other per-viewport resources for it, so dynamic resolution changes do not need a reallocation.
The scale that converts the velocity texture's values to internal pixels.
The output-resolution texture to write the upscaled image to.
The size of [member output], in pixels.
The internal-resolution reactive mask, the alpha channel of [member color].

The render buffers of the viewport being upscaled. Store per-viewport history in it, for example with [method RenderSceneBuffersRD.create_texture] under your own context, so it is freed with the viewport. Do not keep a reference to it after [method TemporalUpscalerExtension._process] returns.
If [code]true[/code], the temporal history must be discarded this frame. [method TemporalUpscalerExtension._reset_history] is called before the same [method TemporalUpscalerExtension._process] call.
The index of the view being upscaled. It is always [code]0[/code], since custom upscalers support one view.
The camera's projection for this view.
The camera's world-to-view transform for this view.
